video_title: The Lakers Sold For $12.5 Billion To Bob Iger & Josh Kushner: What Happens Now?

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Walter sold the Lakers to pay off fraud loans
quotes.excerpt: This was essentially an opportunity for him to gain a quick profit, selling the team
quotes.quote: Bloomberg reported that Mark Walter, who is currently being investigated for loan fraud, was looking to acquire capital to pay off the loans that he is being investigated for. This was essentially an opportunity for him to gain a quick profit, selling the team on a $12.5 billion valuation after he purchased it last summer on a $10 billion valuation. So, he was able to net out plus $2.5 billion, which I assume will help with the loans that he is being investigated for.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' recent basketball moves: hiring Ham and moving on from LeBron
quotes.excerpt: The decision collectively to move on from LeBron James, to not entertain the possibility of him returning
quotes.quote: On the basketball side there have been two notable developments. First and foremost, the hiring of Rohan Ramadas from the New Orleans Pelicans as one of the two assistant GMs under Rob Pelinka. And then, most recently, I think the decision collectively to move on from LeBron James, to not entertain the possibility of him returning on a vet minimum contract or on a discount, and their decision that, hey, we are just moving into the Luka era. We are pivoting here away from LeBron; doesn't matter if he is willing to play for less, it's time to move forward.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Iger's role as the face of the new Lakers ownership
quotes.excerpt: Bob Iger is going to be the face of this operation, he is going to be the face
quotes.quote: Iger is the former Disney CEO from 2005 to 2020, and then again from 2022 to 2026. He is one of the most notable power brokers in media and entertainment. So, he is going to be the face of this operation, he is going to be the face of the ownership group, at least for the time being. Of note, he is a former Clippers season ticket holder, a former Clippers fan. There is actually a clip going around that he was on JJ Redick's former podcast, Old Man and the Three, talking about moving to LA from New York, being a Knicks fan, and that he couldn't quite embrace the Lakers because he was a Knicks fan.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss's future with the Lakers under new ownership
quotes.excerpt: The plan remains in place for Jeanie to serve as the governor moving forward
quotes.quote: Because of the pre-existing agreement between Jeanie and Mark Walter, according to Kobe Bryant of the California Post, Iger said that the plan remains in place for Jeanie to serve as the governor moving forward over that five-year period. But he had an interesting end to his statement. I will read the full statement here: 'We have every intention to honor the agreement that was made between Mark and Jeanie. If things change, they'll change, but we're going into this with enormous respect and appreciation for who she is and what she represents.'
